title: Engine: play-activity recorder (local play sessions store)
description: PlayActivityStore: local, ground-truth play-session records (gameID, startedAt, endedAt) at ~/Library/Application Support/ExeDock/PlayActivity.json, with total hours / session count / last-played queries and a 30s floor that filters ps-flicker noise. Nothing records into it yet - the tracker wiring is the next piece. Answers 'how much have I actually played this' with zero network and zero API keys.
commit_message: Add PlayActivityStore: local play-session records with persistence
author: prepare-chain:claude
